# Sound bank attribution

|---|---|---|---|
| Mck Drum Machines (TR-8, RD-6) | Henri (MckAudio) | [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | https://github.com/MckAudio/MckSamplePacks |
